# Dewllio

> Dewllio is a private home-inventory mobile app for iOS and Android that helps people track their belongings, warranties, receipts, and recurring home-maintenance reminders. Tagline: "Know what you own." Launching soon.

## What it does
- Inventory: catalog every item you own with photos and receipts, organized by room, searchable instantly.
- Warranty reminders: log a purchase date and coverage length; Dewllio reminds you before a warranty lapses.
- Recurring maintenance: schedule repeating home tasks (HVAC filters, smoke alarms, gutters) and get reminders.
- Private & secure: per-account access controls, private file storage, short-lived signed links; data is never sold or used for ads.
- CSV export: export your full inventory any time for insurance or moving.

## Pricing
- Free plan available. Dewllio Premium: US$4.99/month or US$39.99/year (unlimited items, tasks, and storage).

## Platforms
- iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play). Coming soon.
